goal: Prevent identical relayed address announcements from inflating address multiplicity in peer tables
Fixes address freshness checks to account for the initial penalty applied to new entries
agreement: Support because it reduces unwarranted address multiplicity increases (stratospher)
Verified with tests that duplicate announcements no longer inflate multiplicity (frankomosh)
Unaddressed objection: newer announcements are blocked from adding buckets (taki-abedesselam, fametrano)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it fixes a minor logic bug in peer address tracking under normal gossip relay
Provides marginal value since peers can bypass the check by altering timestamps
